# ffxf_load_balancer_metrics (Data Source)

Reads load-balancer request, traffic, connection, and session metrics for the selected time range.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ffxf_load_balancer_metrics" "web" {
  load_balancer_id = ffxf_load_balancer.web.id
  range            = "24h"
}

output "requests_last_day" {
  value = data.ffxf_load_balancer_metrics.web.requests
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `load_balancer_id` (Number)

### Optional

- `range` (String) 1h, 24h, or 7d. Defaults to 1h.

### Read-Only

- `bytes` (Number)
- `errors_pct` (Number)
- `points` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--points))
- `requests` (Number)
- `sessions_max` (Number)
- `step_minutes` (Number)

<a id="nestedatt--points"></a>
### Nested Schema for `points`

Read-Only:

- `at` (String)
- `bytes_in` (Number)
- `bytes_out` (Number)
- `connections` (Number)
- `http_2xx` (Number)
- `http_3xx` (Number)
- `http_4xx` (Number)

- `sessions_max` (Number)
